steps.title: Misty Harbor in Charcoal and Ochre
steps.body: A horizon, and almost nothing standing on it. Warm grey light at the top cools and darkens toward a black ground, and in the band between them a few marks keep their footing: a tall dark post, a long ochre bar bent at one end like a hull, thin spars leaning across one another, drips of gold and a single blue. The quiet is the subject; the marks are what survives it.
steps.alt: Misty Harbor in Charcoal and Ochre
steps.source: https://bambino-1dtu.vercel.app/gallery — Misty Harbor in Charcoal and Ochre; painting by Lorenzo Scardicchio.

steps.title: Windows in Red
steps.body: Nine rooms of colour, each with a window cut into it. The reds, oranges and ochres are laid in square frames, brushed in two directions so every frame has a weave to it, and through each opening a grey-blue sky is scraped in with a knife. One red leaf has landed on the centre pane. From across the room it is a façade at dusk; up close it is nine small paintings sharing a wall.
steps.source: https://bambino-1dtu.vercel.app/gallery — Windows in Red; painting by Lorenzo Scardicchio.
